A1.justification: Both PDFs are readable 34-page versions of the same CSD paper, including Appendices A–E. Text comparison and rendered-page inspection establish correspondence of the equations, figures, tables, and appendix material without material gaps.

before.justification: v2 reports original distillation experiments in Section 4 and Appendix D, including benchmark scores, ablations, efficiency measurements, and generated examples. Table 1 explicitly attributes its results to the authors' implementation.

after.justification: v3 retains the original experiments in Section 4 and Appendix D, including quantitative comparisons, ablations, efficiency measurements, and qualitative model outputs.

M1.justification: The CSD objective, weighting choices, analytic gradient computation, Monte Carlo alternative, and adaptive weighting variants are unchanged in Section 3, Algorithms 1–2, and Appendix D.2.

E1.justification: Both versions retain identical instruction-following, summarization, translation, arithmetic reasoning, and general-chat coverage. The training and evaluation datasets in Section 4 and Appendix C are unchanged.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged throughout the main-text and appendix experiments. The revised AMiD description in Appendix B concerns cited related work; AMiD is not added as an evaluated baseline.

E3.justification: The data splits, model configurations, training budgets, checkpoint-selection procedures, evaluation metrics, and decoding settings in Section 4, Appendix C, and Table 9 are identical.

E4.justification: The weighting and temperature ablations, calibration analyses, logit-offset studies, adaptive-weighting experiments, gradient analyses, and GSM8K case studies are retained unchanged in Section 4.4 and Appendix D.

E5.justification: Both versions report the same five evaluation seeds, [10, 20, 30, 40, 50], and the same mean and standard-deviation reporting in Appendix C.1 and the corresponding tables.

E6.justification: All numerical and qualitative results match, including the tables, plotted findings, and generated examples. For example, CSD retains average ROUGE-L 20.65 in Table 1 and GSM8K accuracy 25.78 in Table 3.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, Proposition 1, Theorems 2–3, Remark 4, and Appendix A proofs and derivations are identical. The revised literature description introduces no formal mathematical change.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about overcoming softmax smoothing and solution-set restrictions, efficient gradient computation, fidelity–diversity trade-offs, and scalability.

C2.justification: Interpretations of mode-seeking behavior, limited-data failures, calibration, minority-token learning, and weighting choices are unchanged, as are the stated applicability qualifications and future directions.

D1.justification: Appendix C's implementation and hyperparameter details, Code 1, Table 9's resource information, and the code-access statement are unchanged. No reproducibility information is added or removed.

R1.justification: Appendix B changes its account of AMiD from matching the student to an assistant distribution within f-divergence to aligning either the student or teacher with an assistant distribution under arbitrary divergence. This broadens the attributed scope of an existing citation; the bibliography and surrounding positioning remain unchanged.

P1.justification: One sentence in Appendix B is revised, including changing 'Amid' to 'AMiD'. The arXiv version/date stamp is updated. The remaining prose, headings, and document structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–13, Tables 1–15, captions, algorithms, and their placement are unchanged. The edited Appendix B passage only rewraps within its existing paragraph; page organization is preserved.

improvement.justification: Appendix B broadens the scope attributed to AMiD, but does not develop that revision into a changed comparison or novelty argument. The CSD exposition, proofs, empirical support, and reproducibility information remain identical. This localized attribution revision does not establish a meaningful overall quality difference.
